# OpenCC dictionary attribution

`TSCharacters.txt` is the Traditional-to-Simplified character dictionary from
[BYVoid/OpenCC, ver.1.1.9](https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC/tree/ver.1.1.9),
by the OpenCC contributors. It is distributed under Apache License 2.0;
the upstream license is included as `OPENCC-LICENSE.txt`.

Upstream dictionary Git blob: `a236514576eed080868c64b4899c46315063ce02`.
Upstream license Git blob: `9f7a310eb2b143dfc4b73551ea60ca17eb2b981f`.

Only static dictionary data is used; the OpenCC executable/library is not
required. The editorial gate derives Traditional-only characters while
excluding ambiguous characters also present as Simplified forms. This is
screening, not a complete context-sensitive script classifier or converter.
